patch_list: Clean Me page
Hide creator center section and selected menus (campaign, FAQs, feedback) on the Me profile page.
Debloat search landing page
Debloats the search landing page by hiding trending searches, discovery modules, and promotional search bar hints.
Disable floating ads
Disables bottom-right promotional floating advertisement overlay.
Disable inner push banner
Disables top slide-down promotional toast and inner-push banner notifications.
Disable player outro unlock card
Disables video player outro unlock video guide bottom-right card.
Disable player overlay ads
Disables video player in-stream bottom-right overlay ad banners.
Disable player recommendation widget
Disables fullscreen video player bottom-right recommendation widget.
Disable player watermark
Hides the top-right brand logo and copyright/premium watermark in the video player.
Disable splash ads
Disables cold-start splash advertisement loading and countdown timer.
Disable tracking
Disables internal Bilibili telemetry, APM profiling, TradPlus ad mediation, Firebase analytics, Crashlytics, and Facebook AppEvents.
GmsCore support
Uses Morphe GmsCore for Google sign-in and sign-out.
Hide bottom navigation items
Hide selected bottom navigation bar tabs (Discover, Create, Chats, Me, Shorts).
Hide home search bar
Hides the search bar on the Home screen.
Hide home tab bar items
Hide selected horizontal tab bar items on the home screen (Featured, Plaza, Subscriptions, Anime, Shorts, Community, Campaigns).
Pure discover search bar
Removes discover tabs and trending searches to make the Discover page a pure search bar.
